name: Semantic Domain Shift to Algebraic Deduction
description: The problem is reframed from physical routing (which strongly cues graph algorithms and Steiner trees) to algebraic deduction of differences between scalar variables. The required "connected component" is disguised as the logical requirement to chain differences, and the "tree" structure is described as a "structurally complete and non-redundant" set of equations. This forces models to logically infer that deducing differences implies graph connectivity, rather than relying on surface patterns like "routing components".
